name: Event ticket
summary: A wallet-style concert or match ticket: a concert photo with the act and venue, date, doors and show time, section, row and seat, a scannable code drawn with tokens, and add to wallet.
use: in a ticketing or events app, for the ticket a fan shows at the door
a11y: The ticket is an article named with the act, venue and date; times and the seat are description lists, the photo has alt text, the code is an image named with the ticket number, and add to wallet is a toggle button with aria-pressed.

use_when: a confirmation screen right after buying, to show the ticket the fan will scan
avoid_when: a flight or train journey: use boarding-pass
choosing a seat before buying: use seat-picker
browsing upcoming events to buy: use media-shelf or calendar-agenda

parts.name: photo
parts.what: the event photo behind the title, under a dark scrim

parts.name: act
parts.what: the act or match, the ticket's heading

parts.name: venue
parts.what: venue and city after a pin icon

parts.name: when
parts.what: date, doors and show time, three across

parts.name: seat
parts.what: section, row and seat, three across

parts.name: code_note
parts.what: the ticket number and a short instruction

parts.name: wallet
parts.what: a toggle: Add to wallet, then In your wallet

parts.name: transfer
parts.what: send the ticket to someone else

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the code cannot be loaded, replace it with an alert-banners line saying to show the ticket number at the door

disabled.how: set disabled on Transfer once the ticket has been scanned or sent

overflow.how: in a very narrow box the two buttons stack full width

long_text.how: times and seat values never wrap, so keep them short; the act and venue wrap onto more lines
long_text.evidence: dd { margin: 0; font: var(--ds-text-title-sm); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Add to wallet, then Transfer
Enter or Space on Add to wallet switches it to In your wallet and back
Transfer is a button with no action in the file
